notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/louislelay__kinova_isaaclab_sim2real --backend fake (exit 0; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 run wD-063 and reviewed_by is null; no human reviewed or tested this package, and no hardware or Isaac Sim run was made. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver is used with the card's entry symbol: native is gen3.tasks.manager_based.gen3_reach.joint_pos_env_cfg:Gen3ReachEnvCfg, the environment configuration named by the registration (source/gen3/gen3/tasks/manager_based/gen3_reach/__init__.py:15-24). The served environment is the registered Gen3-Reach-v0 task, whose entry point isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv lies outside the clone; the fake stands in for it. No deviation from the card or helper, and no catalogue requests: only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. driver.lock.json backends is {"fake": ".fake:FakeGen3ReachEnv"}. The fake backend is the package's own pure-Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py), because Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, PhysX, torch and a GPU are not available here (pretrained_models/reach/env.yaml:20 and :78; README.md:25); the sim backend (gymnasium.make of Gen3-Reach-v0) was not run and the fake was not compared with Isaac Sim. The fake models the recorded contract: seven joints with the env.yaml:144-151 default positions; the reset scales those defaults by 0.75..1.25 (env.yaml:352-360); the action is default + 0.5 * action (env.yaml:339-350); one step is 1/30 s (env.yaml:21 and :76); the policy group carries joint_pos, joint_vel, pose_command and actions, with the recorded uniform noise of +-0.01 on the first two (env.yaml:288-338); the pose command is resampled every 4.0 s from the env.yaml:508-535 ranges; an episode truncates at 12.0 s (env.yaml:369). NOT COVERED: rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator effort and velocity limits (env.yaml:157-165), forward kinematics, the configured reward terms (the fake returns a constant 0.0 placeholder), rendering, wall-clock pacing, snapshot/restore, and the exact torch/numpy observation layout and noise stream; the fake draws reset scales, commands and noise from Python's random.Random, so a seed repeats the fake's own trajectory only. The action space is published as an unbounded seven-value Box because the clone records the joint-position action, scale 0.5 and clip: null but no numeric action bound (env.yaml:339-350, agent.yaml:34); no bound was invented, so the bridge has no action envelope to probe and G8 awards CL2 for SAFE-014. The seven values and the four observation terms have the real widths (7 each; the command is position plus a wxyz quaternion), so no array is shortened. Expected warnings, none a failure: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, close, observation_space, reset and step (the Gymnasium interface and the external ReachEnvCfg base lie outside the clone); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.values and the two seed inputs, which the Gymnasium bridge derives without units. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings: every one of the 25 Facts cites an existing text line of the clone. No site-limits.example.json is needed because the driver declares no limit an operator could narrow. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
